entries.title: Lies of P
entries.definitive_edition: Lies of P plus Overture on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with Overture installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC presentation with expansion content.

primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best current complete version because it has the full base game, the Overture expansion, PC capture/settings flexibility, and good tweak/compatibility coverage. The announced Switch 2 Complete Edition is future-dated and should be revisited after release.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Lies of P on Steam and install Lies of P: Overture. Play the base game first, then access Overture once the required story progress is reached.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC release with Overture DLC available.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-flexibility complete route with the major expansion.
skip: useful platform support, but no content advantage over Windows PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox console release with Overture DLC available.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete console route, but no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.

all_releases.fidelity: PlayStation console release with Overture DLC available.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete console route, but no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Overture expansion is available on the Windows PC primary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: A Switch 2 Complete Edition including Overture is announced for August 2026, after the current date, so it is a future revisit rather than a current primary.
